name: Interior design (expat rentals)
summary: How expats hire interior designers in Singapore for rentals and owned homes — landlord constraints, ID vs contractor scope, and humid-climate material choices.
body:
Interior designers help with layouts, lighting, and finishes when a flat feels unlivable after arrival. Renters need landlord-safe, reversible choices; owners can plan longer renovations with BCA/HDB rules in mind.

## Scope to define
- Styling / FF&E only vs full renovation drawings
- Landlord approval pack for rentals
- Built-ins vs freestanding humid-climate furniture
- Lighting plans for dark HDB / condo rooms
- Project management vs design-only fees

Clarify who buys goods and who owns defects liability.

## How to choose
Prefer designers who show rental case studies and written landlord-friendly specs. Ask about site measurement fees and revision rounds. Confirm contractor tendering is included or separate.

## Practical tip
Photograph every wall and power point before the first consult. Designers quote faster with constraints than with mood boards alone.
